description: Facade attachments of SCNU buildings that their masses (building-forms.json, uni.glb outlines) do not carry, read by stages/buildings.mjs through lib/attachments.mjs. Matched by node (uni.glb BLD_* id). Kinds: balconies (a stack in a recess of the outline: plan of 4 lon/lat corners, open = plan edges that get parapet panels, column = corner index of the full-height column, a slab at every storey floor from fromStorey to toStorey on storeyMetres, a roof frame at roofMetres), fins (boxes width x depth standing out of the wall from wall[0] towards wall[1] at offsets metres, from bottomMetres to topMetres, or thickness thick at each of levels for horizontal ledges), mast (rooftop lattice mast at a lon/lat point standing on baseMetres, heightMetres tall), block (a prism over a 4-corner plan with the facade cells of look, up to topMetres or the building's height, then bandMetres of plain wall and a parapet; e.g. brick end towers 0.3 m proud of a panel facade, a glass core in front of a brick wall, or a blank cladding 0.12 m outside a wing's windowed walls), roof (recolours the roof of the form mass holding the lon/lat point at, e.g. a green-tiled porch roof the photo samples as grey). Heights are metres above the building's lowest ground. Positions are taken from the vertices of the building's own outline in building-forms.json (lon/lat), widths and heights read on the SCNU 360 VR tour cube faces (vr.scnu.ac.kr/360vr, scene_<code>; visual reference only, no image copied or linked) and the NGII 2025 orthophoto sheet 34702020. Every value is estimated (추정), not surveyed.
sources: SCNU 360 VR tour, https://vr.scnu.ac.kr/360vr/tour.html, viewed 2026-10-26 as a visual reference only
NGII 2025 orthophoto sheet 34702020, 0.25 m (국토지리정보원; read locally, not committed; licence decision D2)
data/building-forms.json outlines (VWorld LOD4, 출처: 브이월드; uni.glb)

attachments.source: VR scene_e8 r (cols 60-440 of 1024): red balcony stack with a corner column and a roof frame at the courtyard end of the north wing's east wall, slabs at storeys 2-7; plan = the recess of the LOD4 outline between the stair core, the courtyard wall line and the east wall line (3.7 x 3.6 m; estimated)

VR scene_e8 l (cols 760-930 of 1024): red balcony stack with a corner column and a roof frame at the courtyard end of the south wing's east wall, slabs at storeys 2-6; plan = the 3.6 m recess of the LOD4 outline in front of the wall up to the courtyard wall line (3.6 x 7.2 m; estimated)

VR scene_e8 f (cols 850-1095 of 2048): full-height teal glass curtain-wall core rising from the green porch roof to just above the brick bays at the centre of the courtyard's west side; plan = the 8.6 m chord of the bowed east face of the raised centre block (LOD4 outline), 1.0 m behind it to 1.3 m in front (its 1.0 m bulge plus 0.3 m), from the porch eave (7.7 m) to the block's parapet top (30.83 m), eight storeys like the block (estimated)

VR scene_e8 f (cols 660-1250 of 2048): the hipped porch roof over the two-storey entrance block is dark green tile with grey weathering (the NGII/VWorld photo samples it grey); recolours the raised hipped mass of the LOD4 form (estimated)

VR scene_b4 r (cols 470-615 of 1024): four red vertical fins low on the blank west wall of the four-storey west wing, near its north corner; wall = that wing's west edge in building-forms.json (18.7 m), fin width, spacing and heights scaled from the wall height (estimated)

VR scene_b3 r/b (r cols 920-1024, b cols 0-310): five red horizontal ledges on the grey ribbed north wall of the rear wing, over its western 6 m, also seen at the west end in scene_b2 f; wall = that wing's north edge in building-forms.json (10.2 m), levels from the ledges' elevation angles at the scene_b3 station (13.8 m camera, 13 m to the wall; estimated)

VR scene_b4 r (cols 1480-1830 of 2048): the four-storey west wing behind the red fins is a windowless light grey-white wall up to its parapet, not the teal glass bands of the front; plan = that wing's outline in building-forms.json grown 0.12 m (the fins and ledges are 0.12 m deeper to stand out of it), facade to the roof (20.5 m) and the 2.04 m parapet band (estimated)

VR scene_b3 b/r (b cols 0-620, r cols 1700-2048 of 2048): the rear wing's north wall under the five red ledges is blank grey ribbed panel without windows; plan = the rear wing's outline in building-forms.json as a quadrilateral grown 0.12 m, facade to the roof (20.82 m) and its 0.9 m parapet (estimated)

VR scene_c3 f (cols 555-600 of 1024): grey lattice telecom mast with a two-tier antenna cluster on the seven-storey rear block above the glazed stair core; foot from its shadow on the NGII 2025 sheet moved back by the roof's relief lean (-0.046, -0.223 m per m at 29.3 m); height read against the storey grid (estimated)

VR scene_c3 f (cols 850-1050 of 2048): teal glass stair tower at the centre of the brick front, over the entrance canopy, rising about 2 m above the parapet under the rooftop mast; plan = the 25.3 m front core of the BLD_Training Lab Building form (mass 7, 6.3 m wide, 1.2 m proud of the front wall, centred on E 243781.0, N 263935.6), widened to 6.6 m, 1.6 m proud and 1.0 m deep so the glass replaces the brick projection the form draws there (estimated)

VR scene_a13 f (cols 240-390 of 1024: the left brick tower with the A13 웅지관 sign) and scene_a15 l (cols 440-480): orange brick end tower over the last 7 m of the north-west wing, 0.3 m proud of the white panel walls, 0.9 m above the roof; outline = the wing end of the uni.glb outline (estimated)

VR scene_a13 f (cols 570-665 of 1024: the right brick tower over the pilotis entrance): orange brick end tower over the last 7 m of the bar's west end, 0.3 m proud of the white panel walls, 0.9 m above the roof (estimated)
VR scene_a15 l (cols 720-765 of 1024): orange brick end tower over the last 7 m of the bar's east end, 0.3 m proud of the white panel walls, 0.9 m above the roof (estimated)

VR scene_e7 r (cols 0-1200 of 2048, bearings 260-290 deg from the station): the north end of the north wing is a teal glass curtain-wall block in white frames as tall as the parapet band, the brick ribbons end at it; plan = the wing's outline from N 263622 to its end wall (building-forms.json BLD_E7 vertices 13-17), 0.3 m proud (estimated)

VR scene_e7 l (cols 1800-2048) and f (cols 0-120): the east end of the east wing's north face is a full-height teal glass tower in white frames, a yellow edge strip at its corner; plan = the 7 m tall mass at vertices 33-34 of the BLD_E7 outline (the LOD4 core of 22.2 m), 1.6 m out and 1.5 m in (estimated)
VR scene_e7 l (cols 1800-1900 of 2048): the glass of the tower wraps the first 5 m of the east end wall from the north-east corner (estimated)

VR scene_e7 f (cols 1270-1420 at 1600 px): the teal glass stair shaft in the inner corner, rising a storey above the wings with a white cap; plan = the 24.5 m core mass of the BLD_E7 form (white-capped box on the NGII 2025 sheet), 0.2 m proud (estimated)

VR scene_e7 f (cols 1420-1720 at 1600 px): between the corner shaft and the north wing a recessed glazed link with an orange-red frame grid from the second storey to the parapet; plan = the north-east wall at vertices 22-23 of the BLD_E7 outline (the red bars on the NGII 2025 roof), 0.4 m proud (estimated)

VR scene_e7 f (cols 1070-1270 at 1600 px): the east wing's bay beside the corner shaft is red brick in a yellow frame grid with small windows; plan = the north wall at vertices 30-31 of the BLD_E7 outline, 0.25 m proud (estimated)
